_capture_note: Gap-audit fixture (2026-10-22): rich identify dry-run through the orchestrator local plane with every chromatography layer's metadata, a seeded isolation record, taxon metadata and UV/RT/purity inputs. Sections: analysis_response (POST /analysis), run_status (GET /runs/{id}), citation, task_outputs (the ranks each layer's task produced — the data a result panel renders). NOTE: in the dry-run the apply-chromatography-layers task received zero ranks (it ran before elucidate), so the section layer_chain_over_ranks additionally runs the REAL backend chain (layer_chain.apply_chromatography_layers — the exact function the layers tool calls) over the elucidate ranks with the same metadata, to expose the full CandidateRank field surface a user-facing report must render.

tasks.description: Load the bench isolation record (fractions, TLC, yield) for the supplied extract_id (ADR-0055)
Resolve the sample's species via the taxonomy service (GBIF, ITIS fallback)
Query LOTUS/KNApSAcK/NPASS for compounds reported from the taxon
Run the chromatographic evidence layers (Level-1 home library match, RT/RI reranking, UV chromophore, peak purity, pharmacopoeial markers) over the ranked candidates (ADR-0061..ADR-0066)
Rank structural candidates against the spectra, then rerank with the chromatography layers (ADR-0061..0066), the isolation evidence (ADR-0055), the taxon prior and solvent compatibility (ADR-0052)
Search PubMed for the top candidate reported from the sample species (compound AND species)
HUMAN CHECKPOINT: review evidence (including taxon prior) before any CONFIRMED identification claim
Record the identification claim after approval
Generate a natural-language explanation of the evidence
